blocks.html: The Dr. Yashwantrao Dode World School’s S’cool’ fest *Zest Fest 2022 was a grand success and UEMS Ventures was ecstatic to be a part of it as the overseas education partners and kiosk holders. The fest saw an enthusiastic participation of students and parents who were eager to explore various career options and opportunities to study abroad.

UEMS Ventures took this opportunity to showcase their services of Eval- the career-clarity test and study abroad guidance to the students and parents at the fest. Eval is a comprehensive tool designed to help students discover their true potential and make informed decisions about their future careers. It helps them identify their skills, strengths, and interests and recommends suitable career options based on their unique profile. UEMS Ventures also provided students with expert guidance on the admission process, scholarships, and visa requirements for studying abroad.

The UEMS kiosk at the fest was abuzz with activity, with students and parents eager to learn more about the services offered by the company. The team at UEMS Ventures was more than happy to assist them with their queries and guide them towards the right career path.

UEMS Ventures would like to express its sincere gratitude to the hosts of the fest and to all the students and parents who visited their kiosk. The company remains committed to providing quality career guidance and study abroad services to all its clients.

If you’re a student or a parent looking for career guidance or exploring study abroad opportunities, UEMS Ventures is here to help. Contact them today to schedule an appointment with their team of experts and take the first step towards a successful and fulfilling career.
